translations.answer: Cannot. The post only shows AI Sapiens completing outdoor movement, and the response is still asking how QDD should handle high temperatures; missing temperature, current, duration, and derating data, so thermal safety remains unresolved.
translations.applicability: Applies to high-temperature continuous operation acceptance of QDD humanoid robots.
translations.credibility.rationale: The answer has not closed or there is a conflict; only problem clues are formed.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Record temperature, current, torque, duration, and derating events of windings/drivetrain; missing in original post.
translations.details.environments.0: 38°C Seoul outdoor; 1.3 m, 34 kg, 23 DoF humanoid.
translations.details.limits.0: Cannot infer continuous thermal safety from successful video.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Visible demonstration completed, but thermal performance is not quantified.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Is the thermal margin and derating sufficient during 38°C outdoor operation?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: High-temperature tests should set temperature/current protection and automatic derating; cannot only observe if it falls down.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: High environmental temperature reduces thermal margin.
translations.details.symptoms.0: Original post did not report thermal events, only showed pressure test.
translations.media_summaries.0: Screenshots mainly show platform specifications and 38°C description; no temperature curve, thermal image, or actuator log.
